definitions.pullback_stable: T^{-1}(E) subset E, equivalently T(x) E T(y) implies x E y
definitions.join: E union F followed by equivalence closure
definitions.range_gap: A join path between image points requires an internal vertex outside image(T)

hypotheses: E and F are equivalence relations on X
finite_theorem.conclusion: T^{-1}(E join F) subset E join F
finite_theorem.proof_method: finite bipartite incidence graph of E-classes and F-classes

surjective_theorem.conclusion: T^{-1}(E join F) subset E join F

compact_counterexample.space: one-point compactification of N with two isolated points

prohibited_interpretations: Do not interpret finite computational PASS as Lean certification
Do not interpret zero sampled counterexamples as universal absence
Do not interpret the finite theorem as an arbitrary-set theorem
Do not interpret compactness plus continuity as sufficient
